fusions.name: Musk Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeking Shove
fusions.desc: A reeking shove that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 2 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It has a 60% chance of [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Warning Stance
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spray Back
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by something other than fire, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 12 seconds.
